criteria.rationale: Fourteen scoped requirements allocate original IMP parents/F60-F63 to twenty specified unrun cases; source allocation only.
Concrete local registration/measurement/assessment/advice shapes and five active owner pairs; source trust, full clock/compatibility/statistical/backend semantics remain open.
One immutable ledger and narrow JSON/scalar/probability adapter reuse existing ports; no mandatory new evaluator/model package.
Original forecasts, separate confirmations, fixed source cut/selection, raw provenance, missing denominators and fallible diagnoses remain explicit in source.
Finite context/replay/payload/artifact/time/quota and prepaid terminal records coded; hard isolation/indexed scale/HA/full costs unmeasured.
Idempotent immutable artifacts, late confirmation and staged exact C3 receipt recovery coded; no crash/clock/disk/concurrency/restore case executed.
Existing prospective comparison plan reused; proper quadratic scoring primary paper linked with narrow assumptions and no new statistical-performance claim.
Only AST/import/parser/JSON/TOML/link/trace/inventory/schema source checks; no store, registration, scan, score or product execution.

findings.detail: Separate immutable forecast payload from post-commit acknowledgement confirmation; late retry cannot be backdated.
Pin explicit outcome watermark; inspect first matching source occurrence including pre-registration and bad/censored/generated data.
Block earlier unclassifiable records rather than select a favorable later match; preserve the problematic C1 reference.
Raw source/workspace/epoch/hash/time/unit/lineage checks and sealed input-source overlap policy remain explicit.
Missing/censored/unscored denominators retained; suitable finite scalar/Brier loss and prespecified descriptive bins only.
Error categories and revision causes remain unestablished/attributed, with retained rivals and new verification burden.
Revision targets pinned and dependent impact truncation preserved; no admission/retirement/resurrection or hidden rebase.
Prepay confirmation and C3 receipt records; exact staged patch reconciles a lost local receipt.
Distinct C4/C5 facades and lazy six-owner composition expose native endpoints without new C2/C7 bypass.
Finding drafts and inquiry coverage/resource accounts do not become automatic action, independent usefulness or advantage.

whole_system_review.ownership: C1 evidence, C3 admitted model, C5 trial state, C6 sealed expectations/assessment, C0 workflow and C7 adoption stay separate.
whole_system_review.timing: Post-commit confirmation and fixed outcome cut close local timestamp/retry gaps conditionally on clock trust; no external time/global-knowledge proof.
whole_system_review.feedback: Generated output cannot become raw independent outcome; shared source/group dependence, selection, missingness and unknown causes remain visible.
whole_system_review.saturation: Finite bounded prefix/context/page/state and cooperative time admission; native source intake does not initialize assessment/model/solver stores.
whole_system_review.recovery: Original artifact outcomes, prepaid confirmations/receipts and exact C3 staging retained; full restore/migration/HA and physical disk repair remain open.
